# spokes-api/types/v1/transaction_context.proto



## Types

<a name="github.spokes.types.v1.TransactionContext"></a>

### TransactionContext
TransactionContext is a common structure containing transaction-related
state for clients to propagate to subsequent requests.


| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| transaction_state | [bytes](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/proto3#scalar) |  | <p>transaction_state is the updated transaction state after performing a write.</p> |
